items.name: Member-scoped assistant
items.summary: Give an installed agent a goal; review its proposed actions before confirming them.

items.name: Agent run and execution chain
items.summary: Inspect the original run trace, structured drafts and cross-application execution links.

items.name: Application runtime diagnostics
items.summary: Inspect authorized current and historical resource-linked runs without claiming exclusive application origin.

items.name: Application sessions
items.summary: Share declared presentation state across pages of one scoped application instance.

items.name: Controlled page composition
items.summary: Render original Page sections with shared selection and filters; composition disables writes.

items.name: Published code function call
items.summary: Bind a published Go/Wasm operation to a page using its original owner contract.

items.name: Bound dashboard
items.summary: Render the existing chart specification over the member’s permitted aggregates.

items.name: Decision confirmation
items.summary: Match one decision's confirmation to its original tenant and idempotency key.

items.name: Declared dependency graph
items.summary: Inspect forward dependencies and reverse impact from the original versioned asset description.

items.name: External observations
items.summary: Read current protocol points with quality and timestamps, or external time-series windows for compact business decisions through the original action.
